phases.description: CLI init, scaffold, Wix data collections (SyncState, AppConfig), permissions, and project architecture. Establishes the Wix CLI TypeScript monorepo structure and backend/frontend separation.
phases.label: PHASE 1
phases.name: Foundation

phases.description: GMC OAuth (two-phase Cloudflare Worker relay), productMapper for GMC, validator, gmcClient, and full catalog sync. Phase 2 is the shippable GMC-only MVP.
phases.label: PHASE 2
phases.name: GMC MVP
phases.summary: GMC OAuth, mapper, validator, full sync

phases.description: Webhook handlers (product created/updated/deleted), incremental sync via Wix product events, SyncState writes, and the sync status dashboard page.
phases.label: PHASE 3
phases.name: Incremental Sync

phases.description: Compliance check standalone feature, rulesEngine, filterEngine, FixWizard fix-staging UI, compliance-apply-wix/gmc, AI description enhancement via Anthropic, and multi-variant SKU sync back to Wix.
phases.label: PHASE 4
phases.name: Compliance Workbench
phases.summary: Rules engine, fix wizard, AI enhancement

phases.description: Meta OAuth two-phase flow, dual-platform sync via metaClient, Wix paid plan billing integration, and per-product platform targeting UI in the Products tab.
phases.label: PHASE 5
phases.name: Meta + Billing
phases.summary: Meta sync, billing gating, platform UI

phases.description: Field mapping UI for brand/gtin/mpn custom fields, App Market listing submission, pre-launch test coverage, webhook reliability hardening, and final production cleanup.
phases.label: PHASE 6
phases.name: App Market Launch
